Voorlezen gebruikt de stem van het toest: Reading aloud uses the voice on the pupil's device. If there is no Flemish voice, the pupil first sees a message and then hears another Dutch voice. If there is no voice at all, LANcelot asks the pupil to raise their hand. The live overview then shows 🗣 or 🔇 next to the name.
Leerlingen kunnen het geluid testen met: Pupils can test the sound with the "Test sound" button in My tasks and before a test.

Met een sleutel van een spraakdienst maa: With a key for a speech service, LANcelot makes the sound itself. Every pupil then hears the same voice, even on a Chromebook without voices. Without a key, without internet or above the limit, the pupil's device reads aloud, as above.
Om het geluid te maken gaat de voorleest: To make the sound, the text to read goes over the internet to the speech service, never pupils' names. LANcelot makes everything when you give a task and keeps it on this PC, so the lesson itself works over the local network.
